notes.title: Update to version 61h (join games in progress)
notes.content:
Changes:
- now is possible join games already in progress
- possibility to create private match
- modified Cutter engine sound
- added destroyable fence in Landmark map
- ESC menu is possible to close by ESC key now
- increased volume of Ripper horn
- game now start automatically when everyone are ready
- fixed camera in SkyBlocks while player is on wall
- fixed car deformations
- fixed occassionally black Landmark map
- fixed Cutter back bars animation limit
- fixed missing "2" in steal message where should be "m^2"
- fixed toolbar app icon
- removed "sort by" button from server browser

notes.title: Update to version 60 (experience for single game)
notes.content:
Changes:
- added experience points for solo games!
- changed tyre friction (cars have better grip)
- added one spawnable haystack in Osmicka map (cut all grass on middle roofs)
- added easter egg in Osmicka map (hint: sunflower)
- added experimental controller support
- fixed wheel upgrade for Cutter
- fixed middle collision in Column map (you could fall inside sometime)
- rearranged maps in host menu
- removed uncollectable haystacks from Osmicka map
- tested and aligned all playerstarts in Sky Blocks map (sometimes caused bugs)
